Description: Barajas Psychological Services (BPS) provides psychotherapy and psychological assessment to adults and adolescents with emphasis on the treatment of mood, anxiety, and panic disorders, men's issues, cultural concerns, interpersonal effects of substance abuse, and challenges related to sex and sexuality. BPS also provides comprehensive psychological assessment related to intelligence and ADHD testing, Autism Spectrum Disorders, and career counseling. BPS is owned and operated by Mark Barajas, PhD, licensed psychologist #30042. Dr. Barajas, originally from Sacramento, CA, completed his doctoral training at Western Michigan University and post-doctoral training at University of California Berkeley. He also holds a lifetime California Clear Science Teaching Credential and is fully Spanish-English bilingual.
